**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 236 **Requirements** You have at least one hand free. The target can't be more than one size larger than you. --- You try to knock an item out of a creature's grasp. Attempt an [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) check against the target's Reflex DC. **Critical Success** You knock the item out of the target's grasp. It falls to the ground in the target's space.
**Success** You weaken your target's grasp on the item. Further attempts to Disarm the target of that item gain a +2 circumstance bonus, and the target takes a –2 circumstance penalty to attacks with the item or other checks requiring a firm grasp on the item. The creature can end the effect by Interacting to change its grip on the item; otherwise, it lasts as long as the creature holds the item.
**Critical Failure** You lose your balance and become [off-guard](/Conditions.aspx?ID=58) until the start of your next turn.
name: Disarm
